sample_unit: queries (top searched erectile dysfunction terms, each given to five chatbots)

links.outcome: Readability of chatbot responses (Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level and Reading Ease) to erectile dysfunction queries
links.effect: None of the five chatbots reached the necessary readability level; Bard was the most readable (higher FKRE and FKGL, p = 0.001), and Copilot had the best EQIP and DISCERN quality ratings (p = 0.001).
links.quote: None of the AI chatbots achieved the necessary degree of readability.

screen.reason: Compares readability and information quality of responses from five LLM chatbots to common patient queries about erectile dysfunction without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
